findings.description: A Content-Type parameter with no '=' such as 'text/html; charset' now stores the value as the boolean True, and get_encoding_from_headers then calls .strip() on it, which raises AttributeError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a response header 'Content-Type: text/html; charset' (charset with no value). The changed parser now stores params['charset'] = True instead of skipping the token. Line 544 then calls True.strip(...), which raises AttributeError. Previously the token was ignored and the function fell through to ISO-8859-1. The impact is that reading r.text or r.encoding for such a response raises an exception instead of returning a result.
